newsitem.title: GERMANY: Trains collide, explode in Germany, no injuries.
newsitem.headline: Trains collide, explode in Germany, no injuries.

text.p: Two freight trains collided near Frankfurt's southern station overnight, causing a petrol-filled locomotive boiler to catch fire and explode, but nobody was injured, German railway police said on Wednesday.
The explosion caused flames to jump 20 metres (yards) into the air. About 100 fire fighters tackled the fire for several hours before putting it out.
Inhabitants in the nearby suburb of Sachsenhausen were evacuated because of clouds of smoke, but police said there had been no dangerous chemicals on board either of the trains.
The German railway, Deutsche Bahn, said there could be delays to high-speed trains which would normally pass the accident site.
They did not give an estimate for the cost of the fire damage.
